source_scope.source_detail_limit: Eleven overview assets have same-name detailed definitions. Order detail reverses order/detail in CREATE, while three AI overview assets normalize ri/di alternatives to ri but detailed DDL defines di. These four conflicts remain provisional until source-qualified mappings resolve physical tables.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name DDL plus explicit Ticket/Order-link/Message/Task/Taxonomy/Attachment/Assignment/Quality/Risk/AI authority, restricted-data handling, lifecycle and runtime gate.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production full-denominator reconciliation with exact tenant, ticket, Principal, Order/Item, model/version, message/evidence and immutable decision lineage.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Ticket, assignment, task, message, attachment, review, risk and AI observations append; mutable snapshots are projections and taxonomies publish immutable versions.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Deletion or recall retires visibility but retains legal/audit lineage, payload digest and restricted evidence under purpose-bound retention.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, Principal/operator/group, Ticket, Order/Item, Catalog, taxonomy, message, attachment, review policy, risk policy and AI application/workflow/model versions; quarantine conflicts and raw secrets.

ticket_case.grain: one stable tenant-scoped Ticket with immutable status/assignment observations
ticket_case.identity: Ticket, session, call, service case, Order/Item, Principal, Merchant and Catalog ids remain qualified distinct identities
ticket_case.money_or_quantity: scores/counts are typed measures, never money; commercial amounts remain Order authority
ticket_case.history: state, reopen, forward, reminder, evaluation and close facts append with dictionary versions
ticket_case.security: title/content, call/session and actor/customer data are restricted and excluded from broad analytics
ticket_case.authority: Customer Service owns Ticket; Order/Catalog/Identity own referenced business entities

message_content.grain: one immutable message/comment observation with exact conversation/Ticket and author
message_content.identity: message, comment, session, Ticket, Principal/operator and attachment ids remain distinct
message_content.history: send/read/recall/moderation/solution facts append; edits publish revisions
message_content.security: rich text, chat, files, names and model answers are restricted evidence with payload digest
message_content.authority: Customer Service owns conversation evidence; Identity owns actors; AI output is advisory evidence only

workflow_task.grain: one Ticket task/node version with exact parent, owner, assignee, group and organization
workflow_task.identity: task, parent task, Ticket, Principal, group and organization ids remain distinct
workflow_task.money_or_quantity: priority and counters are typed dictionaries, not quantities or money
workflow_task.history: assignment, delegation, reopen, completion and cancellation append; no overwrite
workflow_task.security: delegate_info and actor display data remain restricted
workflow_task.authority: Customer Service owns task workflow; Identity/Organization own actors and groups

taxonomy.grain: one immutable taxonomy version with stable node identity and hierarchy
taxonomy.identity: source row id, leaf cause/type id and canonical taxonomy node/version remain mapped not equated
taxonomy.money_or_quantity: no money or operational counter authority
taxonomy.history: label/hierarchy changes publish versions; deletion retires future selection only
taxonomy.security: labels are governed content and must not contain personal evidence
taxonomy.authority: Customer Service owns source/type taxonomy; each Ticket freezes exact version

attachment.grain: one immutable attachment reference/version linked to exact Ticket and optional Comment
attachment.identity: attachment, object-storage blob, Ticket, Comment and uploader Principal ids remain distinct
attachment.money_or_quantity: file size/type are typed metadata, never business quantity
attachment.history: upload, scan, redact, supersede and retire append; URL mutation cannot replace history
attachment.security: URL/name/description/content are restricted; canonical events store object token, digest, media type and malware result
attachment.authority: Customer Service owns attachment metadata; secure object storage owns bytes

operator.grain: one qualified customer-service operator assignment/profile version
operator.identity: source operator, canonical Principal, credential, group and role assignments remain separate
operator.security: password is rejected; real name, email and mobile are tokenized/restricted
operator.authority: Identity owns Principal/credentials; Customer Service owns service-role assignment

quality_risk.grain: one immutable quality or risk review decision against exact Ticket evidence and policy version
quality_risk.identity: review, Ticket, Order, Principal, reviewer, policy and remediation case ids remain distinct
quality_risk.money_or_quantity: score is typed with scale; no refund, block or compensation effect is inferred
quality_risk.history: model/strategy/operations decisions and remediation append; later review never overwrites
quality_risk.security: ticket text, user/order links and reviewer names are restricted evidence
quality_risk.authority: Quality/Risk owns decision; Ticket remains Customer Service authority; effects require owning-domain commands

ai_evidence.grain: one immutable AI invocation/result observation bound to exact application/workflow/model/prompt schema and Ticket evidence
ai_evidence.identity: invocation, provider request, model version, Ticket, message and human decision ids remain distinct
ai_evidence.money_or_quantity: confidence/token/cost metrics require typed units and never become business decision authority
ai_evidence.history: attempt/result/feedback append; retries keep provider ids and payload digests
ai_evidence.security: raw prompt/response and personal/order evidence remain restricted; public events carry digests and typed outcomes only
ai_evidence.authority: AI Operations owns invocation evidence; Customer Service/Risk owns accepted decision and downstream effect
